question: Can a single bounded tokenless exact direct-weight learner construct a higher-order action relation through composition of a previously learned public triple with each observed state coordinate, then retrieve old vs new action laws from prior public action consequences without oracle regime labels, while retaining old-law predictions after switching?
hypothesis: From 48 strictly public synthetic paired-action FIT states, one public-only 36/12 inner-FIT tournament over compositional expansions (old-selected triple×each of four public state coordinates) will choose product with s3 in each of three frozen seeds, and refitted new-family 10-feature 4-output direct weights will yield disjoint-held new action1 RMSE <=.020, improvement >=.08 vs same-ridge nine-feature parent in all 3 seeds. A single two-slot retained model (frozen old action law plus new composed law) selecting the better match from the MOST RECENT witnessed action1 public consequence in the same episode will attain <=.020 later-step RMSE separately in old-only, new-only, and new->old held episodes, with first/new switch steps scored separately. A conventional independently fitted same-info batch polynomial + switching-recency control must tie within 1e-8 and may be more efficient. An unrepresented fifth-order action effect is an explicit negative; no scientific novel-world claim.
